  "overall_experience": "The Operations Manager found Canva to be an excellent tool for quickly creating professional-looking company logos, website pages, and various cards without needing extensive design skills. They appreciated its user-friendly interface and the wide array of templates available, which significantly streamlined their tasks. While generally satisfied, they noted occasional performance slowdowns with more complex projects and wished for more robust customization options for intricate design work."
